# CelestrionX — Full Ecosystem Reference

> CelestrionX (`https://www.celestrionx.com`) is an independent systems engineering, autonomous agent tooling, and digital publishing umbrella.
> Motto: Systems · Intelligence · Culture.

## 1. Architecture Overview

CelestrionX organizes engineering work across three operational pillars:

1. **Systems & Runtimes**: Low-overhead execution sandboxes, headless audio graph compilation, and deterministic vector/UI engines.
2. **Agentic Architectures & Knowledge**: Markdown-driven state operating systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and isolated git-worktree execution loops.
3. **Digital Culture & Preservation**: Bilingual publishing platforms (`stellarpub.celestrionx.com`), compiled digital storybooks, and OTA Godot 4 `.pck` content delivery.

---

## 2. Open-Source Systems

### Auralis (`v0.2.0`)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Celestrionx/auralis
- **License**: MIT
- **Summary**: Headless Audio Graph Compiler & Auditory Telemetry Engine in pure Rust for autonomous AI agents.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Declarative JSON/YAML `Song` manifests with reusable `Pattern` blocks and `Clip` scheduling (`repeat`, `transpose_semitones`, `velocity_scale`), chords, portamento (`slide_to_midi`), and seamless `LoopPoints`.
  - Three synthesis backends: `Synth` (multi-waveform oscillators, ADSR/pitch envelopes, unison detune with constant-power stereo spread, vibrato LFO, 2-op FM, dynamic filters), `SoundFont` (`rustysynth` SF2 with MIDI pitch bend & CC64 sustain), and `Sample` (cached WAV one-shot/pitched playback).
  - Multi-threaded track rendering (`std::thread::scope`) with `LowPass` / `HighPass` / `BandPass` biquad filters, beat-synced `FilterSweep`, `Saturate`, `SoftClip`, `Compressor`, track-keyed `Sidechain`, `StereoWidth`, ping-pong `Delay`, Schroeder `Reverb`, and `master_fx`.
  - Export targets: 16/32-bit WAV with RIFF `smpl` loop chunks, OGG Vorbis with Godot `LOOPSTART`/`LOOPLENGTH` tags, and equal-length `--stems`.
  - Closed-loop telemetry: peak/RMS dBFS, crest factor, stereo correlation, side-to-mid ratio, 32-window Hann FFT spectral energy ratios, time-sliced `sections`, and automated mix `diagnostics`.
- **CLI Quick Start**:
  ```bash
  cargo build --release
  cargo run -- init demo.json
  cargo run -- compile demo.json -o output.wav --stems
  cargo run -- eval output.wav
  cargo run -- serve
  ```
- **MCP Tools (`cargo run -- serve`)**:
  - `auralis_init_manifest`
  - `auralis_compile_audio`
  - `auralis_inspect_soundfont`
  - `auralis_eval_wav`

### Vessel (`v0.6.0`)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/WinPhay/vessel
- **License**: Apache-2.0
- **Summary**: Local, time-traveling container sandbox engine for autonomous AI coding agents.
- **Capabilities**:
  - Host Shield: Executes commands inside an isolated container with only `/workspace` mounted.
  - Headless Browser Sandbox: Built-in containerized Chromium (`vessel_browse_url`, `vessel_screenshot`, `vessel_extract_page`).
  - Resource Quotas & Network Isolation: cgroup RAM/CPU limits and `--network none` airgap mode.
  - Time-Travel Rollbacks & Myers Delta Diffs: Instant filesystem checkpoints (`vessel_checkpoint`, `vessel_rollback`, `vessel_checkpoint_diff`).
  - Workspace Access Policy & Git Worktree Shield: `--read-only`, `--ro-path`, `--deny-path`, and `--worktree` session branches (`vessel_worktree_status`, `vessel_worktree_diff`, `vessel_worktree_commit`).
  - Ephemeral Service Mesh: Isolated PostgreSQL/Redis/MongoDB sidecars (`vessel_spawn_service`) with loopback-only `--service-port` ingress.
  - Secret Redaction & DLP Vault: Automatic egress redaction with controlled `--secret KEY=VALUE` injection.
- **Install**:
  ```bash
  curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WinPhay/vessel/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
  ```

- **Primary Hub**: `https://www.celestrionx.com` — Umbrella directory with sticky Human / Agent mode toggle.

- **GitHub Organization**: `https://github.com/Celestrionx` (`https://github.com/Celestrionx/.github`)

---

## 4. Technical Principles

1. **First-Principles Decomposition**: Strip convention; anchor architecture to bedrock constraints.
2. **Zero Slop & High Signal**: Maximize information density; eliminate filler.
3. **Edge-First Distribution**: Cloudflare-proxied edge routing with Full TLS enforcement.
4. **Deterministic Verification**: Branch isolation (`feat/*`, `fix/*`) and explicit post-verification gates.
